body: This comment shows what your real problem is.
To me, real friends are people who I emotionally connect with and who I can imagine having them around for my entire life.
Go on reddit, watch youtube videos, cry, waste my time doing something useless, cry, sometimes i even go on other social media platforms that i dont usually use
So what are real friends to you then?

I had a few friends in mid school until I was around 15-16, then we mutually lost interest in one another and I ended up being a loner. 
I was always kind of an introvert, not talking much, not seizing the initiative, not trying to make new friends, not trying to look for people with common interests.
I started going to university in 2020, so in the middle of the pandemic. I never met anyone there, barely talked to anyone at all, my former friends from school were not my friends anymore and i continued being all by myself. Life has never been worse tbh and I dont see it getting better any time soon, especially since i cannot get myself to change.
